source: docs/BENCHMARKS.md — measured on a MacBook Pro M2 Pro, 16 GB, Ollama 0.35.1

vision.title: Qwen3-VL 2B Instruct
vision.note: The default. Stays inside the app's resource budget at about 2.9 GB, roughly 3.6 seconds a screenshot, and flagged every sensitive screenshot in the test set.

vision.title: Gemma 4 E4B
vision.note: Sorts more accurately (89% against 75%) and also flagged every sensitive screenshot, but needs about 4.8 GB of memory, above what this app budgets for itself. Worth choosing on a machine with memory to spare.
